tier_1_blockers.description: Long background-task disconnect causes out-of-order delivery on reconnect. Two pieces: (a) proactive reconnect during long background tasks (don't wait for user message — heartbeat-driven reconnect when 2 consecutive intervals miss), (b) causal ordering guarantee in delivery queue (server adds monotonic per-session sequence number; client maintains reorder buffer keyed by sequence; emit messages strictly in sequence order). Cross-package: happy-app (sources/sync/messageQueue.ts), happy-cli (src/api/apiSession.ts), happy-server (sources/app/api/routes/sessionRoutes.ts).

strategic_notes:
Supervisor mode insights from Section 9 of the spec (authoritative starting point):

1. **Shared-primitive amortization is real** — Cycle 1 successfully grouped §5.16+§5.17 (markdown parser), §5.6+§5.3 (Codex popup unification + CommandView overflow), §5.4+§5.5 (header layout). This cycle should continue grouping: all §5.15 Phase-B/C/D tools share BashView/CommandView primitives + the §5.18 inline-compact/sidebar-verbose pattern. PM TRIAGE next pass should keep these as ONE logical group routed to ONE ui-specialist + one dev pipeline (multiple BAs OK, but the visual contract must be unified).

2. **Daemon rebuild is mandatory** for any happy-cli change — Cycle 1 deferred this on §5.9 and earned a CLOSE: NO that took ~2.5 hours to remediate. §5.10 will touch happy-cli (apiSession.ts proactive reconnect); pre-commit checklist for that pipeline MUST include rebuild + restart + live verification.

3. **The MMKV pattern from §5.1 is the canonical example** for any future per-session state work. Mirror storage.ts:834-862 + persistence.ts:191-206 byte-for-byte.

4. **The 'port from prod' pattern from §5.8** is the canonical recipe — locate commit in /root/happy, read files, transcribe (do NOT reinvent). For QA, cross-reference must be `Read /root/happy/...` ONLY, never Playwright to life-ai.app (production).

5. **BA-QA mid-pipeline gate** prevented late-stage diagnosis errors in cycle 1. Keep it.

6. **Quality-gate file-size hook** is the single biggest source of friction. Adding paths to EXEMPT_PATHS is the highest-leverage 15-minute fix. This is OUTSIDE worktree scope (lives in ~/.claude/hooks/) so the cycle's recommendation is to escalate to user, not implement directly.

7. **Codex session provisioning** is the SECOND-most-leveraged unblocker — without it, every Codex pipeline (§5.6/5.7/5.13/5.14/5.15-B/C/D, ~6 of 7 carry-forward Tier 1 items) reverts to source-only verification.

8. **§5.10 is ALONE** — multi-package transport bug; do NOT bundle with UI work. If included this cycle, allocate the entire cycle to it; otherwise defer with a repro harness commit for next session.
